description: Use this to follow a report started with gather_report_start, with its id. Each call waits a while for the report before it answers. While it runs, it returns the stage and how long it has been running: call it again right away, without writing to the user in between, until the status is completed or failed. When it is done: the headline, summary, key findings, the option chosen with counts, themes with how many respondents raised each, simulated quotes, the method and the report link. It starts nothing.
name: gather_report_check
title: Check a GatherHQ research report
